projects.name: Western Archrib Mass Timber Plant
projects.description: 160,000 sq ft mass timber manufacturing plant in Sturgeon County, Alberta. Fully automated production line increasing capacity from 12M to 30-35M board feet annually. Supported by $4M federal IFIT program funding.

projects.name: Esquimalt A/B Jetty Replacement
projects.description: Replacement of aging A and B jetties at CFB Esquimalt to support Royal Canadian Navy operations and future fleet requirements. Part of broader NNBI northern basing plan.

projects.name: CFB Gagetown Recapitalization and Air Defence
projects.description: Over $1B investment at CFB Gagetown including $871M range and training area recapitalization, $172M ground-based air defence infrastructure, and $20.2M transition services building. Up to 2,000 additional soldiers posted over next decade.

projects.name: 5 Wing Goose Bay Energy Performance Upgrade
projects.description: Energy Performance Contract to modernize Central Heating Plant at 5 Wing Goose Bay, replacing diesel systems with electric boilers. Part of potential $8B NORAD NNBI site investment. Construction begins May 2026, completion targeted December 2030.

projects.name: CAF National Military Housing Program Phase 2
projects.description: Approximately 7,500 new Residential Housing Units across 25 sites in 6 regions. Multi-year construction program to address CAF housing shortfall. Spans design, construction, building systems manufacturing.

projects.name: Contrecoeur Container Terminal Expansion
projects.description: Largest eastern port expansion in Canadian history, increasing Port of Montreal capacity by 60%. Funded via $1.16B Canada Infrastructure Bank financing. PM Carney broke ground April 2026.

projects.name: Bitdeer Fox Creek AI and Crypto Campus
projects.description: 99 MW AI and crypto data centre campus in Fox Creek, Alberta. Expected operational by Q4 2026.

projects.name: North Coast Transmission Line (NCTL)
projects.description: Major transmission line project supporting LNG and industrial development on BC's north coast. Construction start expected summer 2026, phased completion 2032-2034.

projects.name: SFU School of Medicine
projects.description: Western Canada's first new medical school in nearly 60 years. Construction begins late 2026 in Surrey, BC.

projects.name: Halifax Infirmary Expansion
projects.proponent: Nova Scotia Health / Build Nova Scotia
projects.description: Part of Nova Scotia's $3.5B Capital Plan 2026-27. Major healthcare facility expansion alongside Cape Breton Regional Municipality healthcare redevelopment. Province's largest capital plan in history.

projects.name: Port of Churchill Critical Minerals Facility and Rail Upgrades
projects.description: $262.5M federal-provincial funding over 5 years for Port of Churchill and Hudson Bay rail line upgrades. Includes $10M Churchill Catalyst Fund and new critical minerals storage facility. Budget 2026 commitment.
